name: tool__ems_select
description: Select rows from a table with optional filtering, ordering, and pagination.

table.description: Table name (e.g. tasks, needs, wants, memories)

where.description: Filter conditions. Bare values match equality; use $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $in for operators.

order_by.description: Sort order. String like 'created_at DESC' or array of strings.
